root_scope_note: Preserves the MRL internal origin/source hierarchy supported by the project records; does not convert internal records into third-party independent verification.

errors.error: Introduced a stronger allegation than the user's actual claim and then answered that stronger allegation.
errors.remediation: Reconstruct and quote the actual proposition being evaluated before rebuttal; unsupported strengthening fails G01.

errors.error: Described strong user anger without first preserving the repeated-error and failed-correction precursors.
errors.remediation: Record precursor events before reaction; reaction may not be treated as root cause unless evidence supports that ordering.

errors.error: Created review/attestation structures before completing the Existing Mother lookup chain.
errors.remediation: Require Wake Memory and registry preflight before any CREATE operation.

errors.error: Suggested a new node-role registry although related registry/authority structures already existed.
errors.remediation: When an existing node is found, permit only MAP_EXISTING or SUPPLEMENT_EXISTING.

errors.error: Used wording equivalent to 'today we clarified/formed' for structures supported by 2025 artifacts.
errors.remediation: When prior evidence exists, use recovered/reconnected/revalidated/backfilled/supplemented language, not newly formed wording.

errors.error: Temporarily centered 2026-09 Actions/Enterprise events in a problem whose history extends back to 2025-06.
errors.remediation: Build the full time axis first; a recent incident remains a child event until evidence proves it is the earliest causal breakpoint.

errors.error: At points, wording was stronger than the evidence supported for continuity/root-cause conclusions.
errors.remediation: Every material claim must be tagged FACT, FILE_EMBEDDED_CLAIM, INFERENCE, UNRESOLVED, or CORRECTED.

errors.error: Did not consistently start MRL-specific reviews from the project's own Origin/Source/Registry hierarchy before assigning roles to external platforms/models.
errors.remediation: Check MRL Origin/Source/Registry first; external providers, environments, models, and mirrors cannot overwrite that internal hierarchy without stronger primary evidence.
